# remnawave_snippets (Data Source)

Lists all Remnawave Xray config snippets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "remnawave_snippets" "all" {}

output "snippet_names" {
  value = [for snippet in data.remnawave_snippets.all.snippets : snippet.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `snippets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snippets))
- `total` (Number) Number of snippets reported by the panel.
